answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit before they wander the ledger, and each identity is seeded by a unique marble drawn from a verifiable random beacon, so duplicated keys collapse to one registered island of collateral. Colluding clusters that reuse entropy across sybil nodes are detected by cross-checking beacon draws against staked commitments, exposing correlated identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
